title: The Lakeland minstrel show of early 1925 folds in Mobile
summary: After vaudeville Young put together a tent minstrel show in Lakeland, Florida; it played Deland and Sarasota and folded in Flemington and Mobile.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: No, she didn't get replaced. Because soon after that, we went down to Tampa, Florida, then we left Tampa... The show was getting ready to end then -- that's the vaudeville tour. Then we went to Lakeland, Florida. We stayed in Lakeland, Florida. There was a guy down in Florida had a big tent and a minstrel top show. So he...
About when would this have been? Was this into 1925 yet?
Yeah, early 1925. So Mr. Young got this show together, and that's the time that we did marching.
So you went back to doing a carnival show.
No, it went back to a minstrel show this time. There wasn't no carnival. Just this. That was all it was, just a minstrel show.
A minstrel show in early '25. And this started in

In Lakeland, Florida. Then he tried... Didn't do much good. He tried it out. We went down to Deland, Florida. Then we went to Sarasota. I'm speaking about the dates we played with this minstrel show. It folded up in Flemington, Alabama.
That's where the minstrel show folded up.
Yeah. Our next date was Mobile, Alabama...
It really folded up in Mobile. That's where it really folded up.
